title: Kissed Umami French Monterey Jack Cheese Macaron
description: A delicate French macaron filled with a rich umami flavored Monterey Jack cheese buttercream and topped with shredded cheese and candy, perfect for a light and showy dessert.

ingredients.name: egg replacement
ingredients.notes: such as flax or chia eggs

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, sift together the almond flour and confectioners sugar.
In a large bowl, whip the egg replacement and vegan butter until light and fluffy.
Gradually add the sifted almond flour mixture to the egg replacement mixture and whip until stiff peaks form.
Transfer the mixture to a piping bag and pipe small rounds onto the prepared baking sheet.
Tap the baking sheet gently to remove any air bubbles and allow the macarons to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to form a skin.
Bake the macarons for 15 minutes, then allow them to cool completely on the baking sheet.
To make the cheese buttercream, whip the shredded Monterey Jack cheese and mushroom duxelles until smooth and creamy.
Pair the macarons by size and shape, then sandwich a small dollop of cheese buttercream between each pair.
Top each macaron with a piece of candy and serve immediately.
